name: n8n-code/n8n-nodes-mastercard-spendingpulse
what_it_holds: An n8n workflow-automation custom node wrapping the Mastercard SpendingPulse API to pull 'monthly sales volume and growth rate data' (retail sales, category cuts) into automation pipelines. No data committed — it's a thin API client requiring a paid Mastercard developer key.
why_useful: Could be a template for how to call the SpendingPulse API programmatically if the team ever gets Mastercard developer credentials, but SpendingPulse itself is licensed/paid and the CLAUDE.md rules bar paid API keys — flagging as a method pointer only, not directly actionable now.
time_coverage: n/a (live API wrapper, no historical data bundled)
themes: Payments and merchant data: Visa/Mastercard SpendingPulse releases, Stripe/Adyen indexes, remittance and cross-border card data, tourism receipts from balance of payments
why_all: Could be a template for how to call the SpendingPulse API programmatically if the team ever gets Mastercard developer credentials, but SpendingPulse itself is licensed/paid and the CLAUDE.md rules bar paid API keys — flagging as a method pointer only, not directly actionable now.

SpendingPulse (Mastercard's aggregated US retail sales report, including a Restaurants/travel-adjacent category) requires a Mastercard developer API key; this is a ready-made client that could pull it on a schedule if the team obtains an API key — a method rather than a dataset, matching the theme's core keyword directly.
